race.comment: ONLY US (1) made it five wins in-a-row last start when flying from the back of the pack and scoring as the favourite. He didn't have all the favours there and still proved too good for his rivals. Drawn better this time around and although he rises in weight, he can extend his winning run. AWESOME LILY (6) turned in a modest performance when 12th last time out over 1750m at this track. That followed a win at this track at the previous outing. Has her share of talent. Should be right in the mix in what looks a suitable race. CANDLELIGHT SHERIF (3) is hard to knock on his recent form, missing by 1L two back before being edged out by ONLY US most recently. Drawn the inside again now and can end his winning drought. ODIN OMEN (11) fought on well for third last start over 1750m at this track, making it two minor placings in a row. Another big run expected. MR HOLLYWOOD (10) is sure to make his presence felt.
